title: Two-tape table skipper
statement: For a natural number $n$, the table skipper attempts to consume from a bit string the encoded actions for a two-tape table with $n+1$ states, covering all three possibilities for each of the input symbol and the two work-tape symbols at every state. It returns the unconsumed suffix if the prescribed encoding can be skipped, and no result otherwise.
caveat: The supplied statement omits the definition of the action skipper, so the exact encoding lengths and failure conditions are unavailable.
